nodes.title: Foundation Phase
nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 2
nodes.description: Grade 2

nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.description: Mathematics for Grade 2 — Foundation Phase CAPS

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 2 Mathematics Term 1 (45 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 200; number concept to 100; place value (hundreds, tens and units); order and compare numbers to 100; addition and subtraction to 99; number sentences

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Geometric patterns: copy, extend and describe; number patterns: copy, extend and describe; create own patterns

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: Position: describe position of objects; 2D shapes and 3D objects: recognise, identify, name, describe, sort and compare

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Time: read and write time in hours and half hours on analogue clocks; sequence events; names of months; Length: estimate, measure, order using non-standard units

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect and sort data; represent data in pictographs; discuss and report on data

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 2 Mathematics Term 2 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 200; number concept to 150; addition and subtraction to 149; grouping and sharing; fractions (halves, quarters and thirds); money: solve money problems

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Number patterns: extend and describe; input and output number patterns; number sentences with missing numbers

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: Symmetry: recognise and draw lines of symmetry in 2D shapes; 2D shapes: sort, describe and compare including sides and angles

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Time: telling time in quarter hours; Mass: compare and order using non-standard measures; Capacity/Volume: estimate, measure and compare

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect, organise, represent and interpret data; bar graphs and pictographs; answer questions about data

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 2 Mathematics Term 3 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 200; number concept to 175; addition and subtraction to 175; repeated addition leading to multiplication; multiplication tables for 2, 5, 10; division with grouping and sharing

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Geometric patterns: extend and describe; number patterns: extend and describe including skip counting in 2s, 3s, 5s, 10s

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: 3D objects: sort, describe, compare and identify; position and views; 2D shapes making up faces of 3D objects

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Time: tell and write time; read calendars; Length: estimate, measure, compare and order in centimetres; Mass: estimate, measure, compare in kilograms

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect data; sort data into categories; represent data in bar graphs; answer questions about bar graphs

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 2 Mathematics Term 4 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 200; number concept to 200; addition and subtraction to 200; multiplication and division; fractions: unitary and non-unitary fractions; money: calculate change

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Number patterns: extend, describe and create; geometric patterns: extend, describe and create; number sentences

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: Symmetry: recognise and draw lines of symmetry; 2D shapes and 3D objects: sort and describe; transformations: tessellations with 2D shapes

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Time: read calendars; Capacity/Volume: estimate and measure in litres; Length: estimate and measure in centimetres and metres

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect and organise data; represent data in bar graphs and pictographs; interpret and report on data
